cues: And the two rays are plane polarized, in planes at right angles to each other: one shown with dots, one with arrows.
A Nicol prism is a calcite crystal cut in two and cemented with Canada balsam, so that the ordinary ray is totally internally reflected away.
Only the polarized extraordinary ray comes out.
